notes.title: Fan Merch and Mods
notes.notes:
Not only has the I Was a Teenage Exocolonist fandom kept the story going with fic (336 works and counting on [url=https://archiveofourown.org/tags/I%20Was%20a%20Teenage%20Exocolonist%20(Video%20Game)/works]AO3[/url]), they’ve been busy modding the game and making rad fan merch. Northway Games has always [url=https://northwaygames.com/contact/]granted permission[/url] for anyone to sell fan merch of our games using their own original art. It feels so amazing to have a piece of Exocolonist fandom hanging from my bag or dangling from my ears, out here in the real world.

So here’s a showcase! [i](this is a repost from the [url=https://northwaygames.com/]Northway Games blog[/url] which is so popular it got 4500 spam comments last month when I accidentally broke the recaptcha)[/i]

[h1]Official-ish Merch from Mei[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/ff08cae73b9dbcfb24fe39c062c3d8814874140d.jpg[/img]
[i][url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]Mei’s wooden charms[/url][/i]

Exocolonist artist Mei ([url=https://bsky.app/profile/bkomei.bsky.social]@bkomei[/url]) just announced preorders for the [url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]cuuuuuuuutest wooden character charms[/url], with unique shapes and different pictures on the two sides. Preorder them here: [url=https://bkomei.bigcartel.com/]https://bkomei.bigcartel.com[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/67476171659acf563ed90e881cb6bc5c5b720cf2.gif[/img]

Mei’s also selling several prints of their in-game illustrations, and making these cool interactive CD jewel case charms that are just beautiful and all kinds of nostalgic. These will be a limited run so get one while you can!


[h1]Official-ish Merch from Lindsay[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/7c314e3ff68e111d7993f92c73bdb679a47feb4f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/d2194b8a3276172dbf717a99ec390377f0098617.jpg[/img]
[i]Poayo’s shop recently added [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/1852002489/begonia-flora-i-was-a-teenage]keychains[/url] from guest artist Begonia[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/1dd1d0b97aa0891ab22e030ffe1df9dd366dd6f7.jpg[/img]
[i]Yes even [url=https://www.etsy.com/ca/listing/1744321500/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist-body-pillow]body pillows[/url] I wasn’t kidding[/i]

notes.title: SimFest 2024
notes.notes:
Simulation games are my favorite genre. Debatably, the way I play some RPGs and strategy games by ignoring main quests or playing in sandbox mode probably makes them sim games too. Hold on, could EVERYTHING be a sim game? I mean they're all simulating something, right?

Let's back it up. I just reinstalled the Sims 4, arguably King of Sims, which is ten years old and still in the top 30 [url=https://steamcharts.com/top/p.2]most played games on Steam[/url]. I never played with dolls as a kid but hoo boy watching these poor creatures slapfighting and peeing themselves in public never gets old.

Despite I Was a Teenage Exocolonist not simulating bladder-fullness, I still hope people get a similar joy from guiding Sol/Solane/Solanaceae through all the many possibilities of adolescence on Vertumna.

Oh, right, and the game is on sale, with a limited time demo, for SimFest 2024 from July 22-29!

- Sarah ːnyaaː

It's been years since I've [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141910/Magic_The_Gathering_Arena/#app_reviews_hash]played online[/url], but I have an unopened box of Lord of the Rings in my closet just waiting to be drafted. Something about the feel - and that [i]smell[/i] - of glue and cardboard.

So naturally when I was designing the deckbuilding component for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148760/I_Was_a_Teenage_Exocolonist/]I Was a Teenage Exocolonist[/url], I was already thinking about how to make a physical game out of it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/04a6f2d658a5eed1b9b0d9fb6a5896e152f8ea46.jpg[/img]

Behold: you can buy it from [url=https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]TheGameCrafter.com[/url] for $14.99 USD!

These are made to order (so it might take a while to ship) and feature 52 UV-coated cards in a cute mint tin, with card art from the game. I originally designed them as promotional merch so I'm selling these at cost.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37830808/a7ae6348c1c100cf15508d6acb67c58c0ef9f856.jpg[/img]

And yes it includes instructions for a playable 1-person game, a simplified version of the minigame in Exocolonist. Shuffle and draw 7 cards, then play a hand of 5 which scores at least 3 points to win the round. Points come from straights, flushes, pairs, or total score, and yes, order matters.

Or screw playing the game, just enjoy the feel of your favorite Exocolonist cards right in your hands. Breathe deeply and smell that hot ink and glue. [url=https://www.thegamecrafter.com/games/i-was-a-teenage-exocolonist]Ahhhhhh[/url].

notes.title: Nominate Us!
notes.notes:
Steam Awards nominations are now open! Time to let the world know about your favorite games released in the last year. Final voting will be held during the Steam winter sale.

You can nominate [i]I Was a Teenage Exocolonist[/i] for any category, but you can only pick one. How abouuuuuut [b]Outstanding Story-Rich Game[/b]?
